subject: Fleet scheduling & contingency for exec offsite — rental car pool and pickup windows
messages:
From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
To: PrestigeCarService <ops@prestigecars.com>, CityParking Ops <parking@cityparking.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Jul 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Fleet scheduling & contingency for exec offsite — rental car pool and pickup windows

Hi team,

We have the Acme executive offsite on Aug 18–19 (approx. 75 guests in and out during peak windows). I want to nail down a plan that minimizes wait time at the curb, provides a small rental-car pool for last-minute needs, and leaves room for surge demand if flights cluster. High-level asks:  

- Prestige: can you provide a 2-tier pickup plan (regular sedan fleet + 4 executive SUVs on standby) with per-hour hold rates and a 2-hour grace window? Please include ETA guarantees for downtown arrivals (I-280 corridor).
- CityParking: can you block two curb lanes at the north entrance for 08:00–10:30 on both days and confirm how many permit placards you’ll issue? Also need a loading/unloading staging area for luggage vans.
- Internal: Marissa — I'd like a rental car pool of ~8 cars pre-booked (mid-size + 2 hybrids) under a single corporate account so EAs can pick up spares if needed. Rishi/Vivek — please confirm driver badge/staging access and who will man curb radios.

I attached a rough pickup-windows CSV (pickup-windows.csv) with attendee arrival clusters. If you can review and return a short proposal (rates, hold policy, cancellation windows) by Friday EOW, we’ll finalize.

Thanks — Logan

--
Logan Wright
Program Manager, Events Ops
Redwood Inference
From: PrestigeCarService <ops@prestigecars.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Cc: CityParking Ops <parking@cityparking.com>
Date: Wed, 21 Jul 2027 09:34:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fleet scheduling & contingency for exec offsite — rental car pool and pickup windows

Hi Logan / Marissa / Rishi,

Thanks for the note and the CSV — good detail. Quick answers below and we can follow with a formal quote PDF:  

1) Fleet tiers: we can provide up to 60 sedans + 6 SUVs. For the two-tier approach you described we recommend: standard hold (15 min free, then $1/min) or paid hold by the hour ($40/hr per vehicle). For the exec SUVs we suggest a 2-hour minimum during peak windows.

2) ETA guarantees: for downtown–to–venue on the I-280 run we guarantee <25 min for dispatched vehicles within our premium SLA; standard fleet SLA is <40 min. During morning rush (08:00–09:30) we recommend pre-positioning 10 cars in the north staging lot.

3) Standby protocol: we’ll assign an on-call dispatcher for the event and provide a single phone line + radio channel for your curb ops. We can escalate to a floating supervisor on-site for an hourly rate.

Attachments: rental-pool-pricing.xlsx (proposal numbers)

We’ll prepare a short, two-page confirmation including hold policy, payment terms (net 30 with a 30% deposit), and an addendum for surge capacity (cost per extra vehicle). Will send by EOD Thursday so you have time for review.

Best,
Marco Santos
Ops Lead
PrestigeCarService
ops@prestigecars.com
From: CityParking Ops <parking@cityparking.com>

Date: Wed, 21 Jul 2027 10:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fleet scheduling & contingency for exec offsite — rental car pool and pickup windows

Logan, Marissa —

We can reserve the north curb (Zones N1 & N2) for 08:00–10:30 on both days and provide four temporary placards for vendor vehicles. Important constraints:  

- The curb must remain open for emergency access; we can stage vehicles in adjacent Lot C for luggage load/unload, with a 20-minute unloading window per vehicle.
- We cannot hold vehicles in the curb zone for more than 30 minutes without a paid permit; paid hourly staging is available at $25/space/hr.
- We will require vendor vehicle manifests 48 hours prior to event for access control. Please send CSV with vehicle plate numbers if you plan to use Lot C staging overnight.

We’ll drop a PDF map (curb-zone-map.pdf) into the shared drive with marked ingress/egress paths.

Thanks,
Maya Patel
Operations Supervisor
CityParking
parking@cityparking.com
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>

Date: Thu, 22 Jul 2027 08:47:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fleet scheduling & contingency for exec offsite — rental car pool and pickup windows

Thanks Marco and Maya — this is helpful. A few follow-ups and decisions from the events team:  

- We’ll go with Prestige’s two-tier plan and take the 4 executive SUVs on standby. Please include the floating supervisor line item in the quote (we’ll approve up to $250/hr if needed).
- CityParking: please bill staging for Lot C at the paid hourly rate for both mornings. We expect ~12 luggage van moves across the two mornings; I’ll provide a preliminary manifest by Friday.
- Rishi/Vivek: can you confirm badge access for vendor supervisors and that radios will be handed to the Prestige dispatcher upon arrival? Also confirm who will be on-site from Redwood between 07:30–11:00 both days.

Logan — Laura (Acme’s EA) asked for a small contingency pool of rental cars (8 total) under a single corporate booking. I’d like us to lock that in today if possible so contracts can be routed.

Marissa
Director, Events
